checks.what: Three independent audits read all 998 cards against the GitHub Docs pages they quote, found word for word by the card checker, including every YAML snippet's syntax and the runner image labels
checks.result: One wrong explanation (letters that did not follow a moved answer) and one unsupported claim about forks fixed; six cards with invalid one-line YAML rewritten; 4 unsupported, 2 ambiguous and 5 unclear cards and 17 minor issues also fixed.
